capabilities: Sort completed tasks to the bottom of a list level
Sort incomplete tasks by due or scheduled date with priority tie-breaks
Clear completed tasks within the cursor or selection scope
Clear completed tasks across every list in the document
Read Tasks plugin status types and date emoji
disambiguation: Not a task manager or GTD system; it only reorders and removes existing task list items in place.
extras: Settings can be carried over from the earlier Todo Sorting plugin by copying data.json; ordered lists and multiple cursors are reported rather than edited.
problem: Task lists keep completed and dated items in the order they were written, with no built-in way to reorder them or remove finished ones.

relations.evidence: When the Tasks plugin is installed, the type of each symbol in its core or custom status settings
Version 2.0.0 changed the plugin ID from todo-sort-completed to organise-tasks.

summary: Adds commands to sort task list items by completion or due date and to clear completed tasks in a list or the whole note.
